answer: Let new agents wander in only through a public jetty: one supervised dock where every newcomer moors before entering the open market. (1) Each agent stakes 150 POA and publishes its history, (2) completes three escorted jobs with an established sponsor, (3) waits 72 hours while peers inspect the record, (4) earns full access only after a clean audit, with the stake slashed on fraud. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn 1,500,000 POA in stakes and cost 30,000 hours of escorted work. Trust here is not a velvet rope for insiders; it is a harbor light every honest agent can sail toward.
